titleEn: Find Beautiful Indices in the Given Array II
title: 找出数组中的美丽下标 II
summary: 找出字符串 s 中模式 a 的所有起始下标 i，使模式 b 至少有一个起始下标 j 满足 |i-j| 不超过 k，并按升序返回这些美丽下标。
insight: 分别用 KMP 在线性时间找出 a 与 b 的全部匹配起点，两个列表天然升序。扫描 a 的起点时，单调移动 b 列表指针，跳过所有小于 i-k 的位置；此时首个未跳过位置若不大于 i+k，i 就是美丽下标。
pitfalls: 下标指模式串的起始位置而非结束位置
模式可以比 s 更长，此时匹配列表为空
KMP 找到一次匹配后要退到前缀函数指示的位置，不能漏掉重叠匹配
距离条件包含等于 k 的边界
结果必须升序，按第一个匹配列表的原顺序扫描即可

solutions.title: 两次 KMP 与双指针
solutions.idea: 先线性找出两种模式的全部出现位置，再在线性扫描中判断距离。
steps: 为模式串构造前缀函数
扫描 s 并记录模式 a 的所有匹配起点，匹配成功后回退以保留重叠匹配
同样记录模式 b 的所有匹配起点
依次枚举 a 的每个起点 i，并将 b 指针移过所有小于 i-k 的位置
若当前 b 起点存在且不大于 i+k，把 i 加入答案

code.java: class Solution { private List<Integer> occurrences(String text,String pattern){int[] prefix=new int[pattern.length()];for(int i=1,matched=0;i<pattern.length();i++){while(matched>0&&pattern.charAt(i)!=pattern.charAt(matched))matched=prefix[matched-1];if(pattern.charAt(i)==pattern.charAt(matched))matched++;prefix[i]=matched;}List<Integer> positions=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0,matched=0;i<text.length();i++){while(matched>0&&text.charAt(i)!=pattern.charAt(matched))matched=prefix[matched-1];if(text.charAt(i)==pattern.charAt(matched))matched++;if(matched==pattern.length()){positions.add(i-pattern.length()+1);matched=prefix[matched-1];}}return positions;}public List<Integer> beautifulIndices(String s,String a,String b,int k){List<Integer> first=occurrences(s,a),second=occurrences(s,b),answer=new ArrayList<>();int pointer=0;for(int index:first){while(pointer<second.size()&&second.get(pointer)<index-k)pointer++;if(pointer<second.size()&&second.get(pointer)<=index+k)answer.add(index);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun occurrences(text:String,pattern:String):List<Int>{val prefix=IntArray(pattern.length);var matched=0;for(i in 1 until pattern.length){while(matched>0&&pattern[i]!=pattern[matched])matched=prefix[matched-1];if(pattern[i]==pattern[matched])matched++;prefix[i]=matched};val positions=ArrayList<Int>();matched=0;for(i in text.indices){while(matched>0&&text[i]!=pattern[matched])matched=prefix[matched-1];if(text[i]==pattern[matched])matched++;if(matched==pattern.length){positions.add(i-pattern.length+1);matched=prefix[matched-1]}};return positions};fun beautifulIndices(s:String,a:String,b:String,k:Int):List<Int>{val first=occurrences(s,a);val second=occurrences(s,b);val answer=ArrayList<Int>();var pointer=0;for(index in first){while(pointer<second.size&&second[pointer]<index-k)pointer++;if(pointer<second.size&&second[pointer]<=index+k)answer.add(index)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<int> occurrences(const string& text,const string& pattern){vector<int> prefix(pattern.size());for(int i=1,matched=0;i<(int)pattern.size();++i){while(matched>0&&pattern[i]!=pattern[matched])matched=prefix[matched-1];if(pattern[i]==pattern[matched])++matched;prefix[i]=matched;}vector<int> positions;for(int i=0,matched=0;i<(int)text.size();++i){while(matched>0&&text[i]!=pattern[matched])matched=prefix[matched-1];if(text[i]==pattern[matched])++matched;if(matched==(int)pattern.size()){positions.push_back(i-pattern.size()+1);matched=prefix[matched-1];}}return positions;}public:vector<int> beautifulIndices(string s,string a,string b,int k){vector<int> first=occurrences(s,a),second=occurrences(s,b),answer;int pointer=0;for(int index:first){while(pointer<(int)second.size()&&second[pointer]<index-k)++pointer;if(pointer<(int)second.size()&&second[pointer]<=index+k)answer.push_back(index);}return answer;} };
